questions.question: Was Theresia Reding born in Arsdorf, Luxembourg in 1846, and who were her parents?

items.rationale: Luxembourg, Church and Civil Registration (collection 5000012) covers Arsdorf civil birth registers. Search for Theresia's birth in the 1840s, which would name her parents.
